remoteTools.name: save_memory
remoteTools.description: Save a one-fact memory entry for yourself (the agent running this step). Use it only when the task instructions ask for it or a lesson is clearly worth keeping. Quota 100 per agent.

sourceTodoId.description: Optional source todo id; defaults to the running task.

remoteTools.name: delete_memory
remoteTools.description: Delete one of your memory entries by id.

remoteTools.name: attachment
remoteTools.description: Fetch an attachment referenced by a task spec or message. Spec tokens of the form ![name](attachment:<teamId>/<id>.<ext>) embed an attachment; call with the bare <id> (the part before the extension). Returns the file content (utf8 for text/* / json / xml, base64 for images / pdf).

remoteTools.name: set_task_meta
remoteTools.description: Set the title and category tag of the task you are currently working on. Call exactly once before starting work: title = a concise summary of the task spec (50 chars max, plain text, no markdown); tag = one name from the fixed tag vocabulary listed in your instructions (omit it when none fits).

tag.description: Optional tag name from the fixed vocabulary.

remoteTools.name: create_skill
remoteTools.description: Create a team skill as a folder in the team skills directory. Requires the 「创建技能」permission switch on your agent row. The SKILL.md frontmatter name and description must match the declared values.

name.description: Skill name; also the folder name and the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

description.description: One-line skill description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

remoteTools.name: update_skill
remoteTools.description: Update an existing team skill by id. Requires the「更新技能」permission switch on your agent row. Listed files are overwritten, unlisted files are kept; include a new SKILL.md to change the frontmatter (including renaming).

name.description: Declared skill name; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description.description: Declared description; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter.

path.description: File path inside the skill folder.

files.description: Files to overwrite; include SKILL.md to change frontmatter.
